1.consolidated_definition: inform. Disco compacto de sólo lectura. Disco que se utiliza para almacenar y distribuir informació. Sigla anglicada, usual. Maldonado señaló que este CD ROM que tiene un contenido tipo enciclopedia es una evolució de la producció “Puerto Rico y sus municipios, imágenes e informació” publicado en 1997
1.en_consolidated_definition:
CD-ROM (inform.) Compact disc for reading only. A disk used to store and distribute information. Anglicized abbreviation, commonly used.

Note: CD-ROM is a widely recognized term in English, so it's not necessary to translate it. However, I included the definition to provide context and clarity.
